Affordable website design for small businesses

Fast, mobile-friendly websites at a fixed price: a one-page site from €495, a business website with up to 6 pages from €995 and a web shop from €1,950.

Website packages

PackageIncludesFrom
One-pageAll key information on one page, contact form, basic SEO, 3–5 days€495
Business websiteUp to 6 pages, SEO copy, quote form, fast loading, 2–3 weeks€995
Web shopUp to 50 products set up, payments and shipping, 3–5 weeks€1,950

What it costs per month

Hosting can be free for most small sites. A domain costs about €5 to €15 per year. Maintenance is optional from €29 per month.

You own it

No lock-in to a website builder. The site, the domain and the content are in your name.

How it works

  1. Tell us about your business by email.
  2. Get a free concept of your homepage.
  3. Approve the design and the fixed price.
  4. We build, you test, we launch.

Frequently asked questions

Will my site rank on Google?

We build every site fast, mobile-friendly and with the technical basics Google expects. Nobody can guarantee a top position.

Do you work worldwide?

Yes, fully online, in English or Dutch. Prices are in euros.

Can I add pages later?

Yes. Extra pages are €95 each, including SEO copy.
